name: Context Squeeze
description: Token-reducing OpenClaw context engine. Keeps recent messages verbatim, compresses older prose with best-effort anchors, and preserves system instructions and tool results. Deterministic, no AI calls.

keepRecentTurns.description: Number of most recent messages kept verbatim.

compressionRatio.description: Target size of compressed cold messages as a fraction of their original size.

minTurnsBeforeCompression.description: Do not compress histories shorter than this many messages.

targetTokenBudget.description: Additional hard prompt budget in tokens. 0 uses the host budget only.

anchorPreserve.description: Preserve paths, commands, addresses, ticket ids, and similar facts as anchors.

minMessageChars.description: Cold messages shorter than this stay verbatim.

debugStatsFile.description: Optional absolute path for append-only JSONL compression stats.
